children: Index operator MSCI will remove Michael Saylor's Strategy
and other companies from its global indexes after determining they more closely resemble investment funds, a move that could curb passive investment flows into the stocks.

MSCI last year proposed to exclude digital asset treasury companies whose holdings represent 50% or more of their total assets and then launched a broader review into what it called "non-operating companies". Such companies have fund type characteristics, which are excluded from its benchmarks, it added.
